business_problem: Churney needed to improve marketing return for clients while avoiding the engineering burden of running model monitoring, drift detection, and large-scale experimentation on its own infrastructure.
solution_summary: Churney built its causal-AI marketing platform on Google Cloud by combining BigQuery’s warehouse economics with managed MLOps capabilities from Gemini platform. BigQuery gives the company a scalable, cost-efficient base for data handling, while Gemini platform lets it test hundreds of models simultaneously and use managed features such as Model Monitoring and drift detection instead of maintaining that stack internally. This setup is central to Churney’s customer-lifetime-value and ROAS prediction workflows, where causal models help businesses focus spend on their highest-value customers. By using managed services for experimentation and monitoring, Churney can keep moving quickly on model quality instead of dedicating whole teams to operational upkeep. The result is a marketing-optimization platform that delivers stronger returns for customers while saving the vendor dozens of hours of maintenance work every week.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Provides scalable, cost-efficient warehouse operations for Churney's causal marketing data and modeling workflows.
